comments.text:
Ranch is an American invention It was invented in Alaska in 1949, then the cook went to work at a vacation ranch in a valley in California in 1952 and thats when it became popular with guests.  He started Hidden Valley Ranch (named after the nickname of the valley) in 1957.  It's very rare to get in Europe.  

A lot of European countries have adopted various culinary traditions of what things can go with others that predate the modern United States.  So for example Brits tend to not think of mixing anything sweet or too salty with meat.  They are just flavor combinations they never thought of trying to put together.  The United States was the land of breaking cultural and society food norms and just trying things.  So we have things and choices here that you will not find anywhere else in the world.
